column2:
dairy(n.)乳製品、乳品店、酪農場
(無詞性變化)
dairy products 乳製品
dairy farm 酪農場
Milk, cheese, and yogurt are dairy products.
(牛奶、起司和優格都是乳製品。)
His family runs a dairy farm in Changhua.
(他家在彰化經營一座酪農場。)

dam(n./v.)水壩、築壩攔(水)
(無詞性變化)
build a dam 建造水壩
dam a river 在河上築壩
The government plans to build a dam on the river.
(政府計畫在這條河上建一座水壩。)
The dam provides water for the whole city.
(這座水壩供應全市的用水。)

dare(aux./v.)敢、膽敢、向⋯挑戰
daring(adj.)大膽的
dare to 敢於⋯
How dare you! 你怎麼敢！
I didn't dare to tell my parents the truth.
(我不敢告訴爸媽真相。)
He dared me to jump into the cold river.
(他激我跳進冰冷的河裡。)

darling(n./adj.)親愛的、寶貝、可愛的
(無詞性變化)
my darling 我親愛的
a darling little girl 可愛的小女孩
Good night, my darling.
(晚安，我的寶貝。)
She was everyone's darling at the party.
(她是派對上大家的寵兒。)

dash(n./v.)猛衝、急奔、少量、破折號
(無詞性變化)
make a dash for 衝向⋯
a dash of salt 一點點鹽
He dashed to the bus stop to catch the bus.
(他衝向公車站去趕公車。)
Add a dash of salt to the soup.
(在湯裡加一點點鹽。)

database(n.)資料庫
(無詞性變化)
online database 線上資料庫
search the database 搜尋資料庫
The library has a large online database.
(圖書館有一個大型的線上資料庫。)
All student records are kept in a database.
(所有學生的紀錄都存在資料庫裡。)

dawn(n./v.)黎明、開端、(天)破曉
(無詞性變化)
at dawn 黎明時
from dawn to dusk 從早到晚
The farmers start working at dawn.
(農夫們天一亮就開始工作。)
It suddenly dawned on me that I had left my keys at home.
(我突然想到我把鑰匙留在家裡了。)

dealer(n.)商人、經銷商、(牌局)發牌者
deal(v./n.)處理、交易
car dealer 汽車經銷商
drug dealer 毒販
He bought a used car from a local dealer.
(他向當地的經銷商買了一輛二手車。)
The dealer gave each player five cards.
(發牌員發給每位玩家五張牌。)

decade(n.)十年
(無詞性變化)
for decades 數十年來
in the past decade 過去十年間
The city has changed a lot in the past decade.
(這座城市在過去十年間改變很多。)
My parents have lived here for decades.
(我爸媽已經在這裡住了數十年。)

deck(n.)甲板、一副(紙牌)、平台
(無詞性變化)
on deck 在甲板上
a deck of cards 一副撲克牌
We stood on the deck and watched the sunset.
(我們站在甲板上看夕陽。)
Can you bring a deck of cards to the trip?
(你可以帶一副撲克牌去旅行嗎？)

decorate(v.)裝飾、布置
decoration(n.)裝飾、裝飾品
decorative(adj.)裝飾用的
decorate the room 布置房間
decorate with 用⋯裝飾
We decorated the classroom for Christmas.
(我們為了聖誕節布置教室。)
She decorated the cake with strawberries.
(她用草莓裝飾蛋糕。)

decrease(v./n.)減少、降低
(無詞性變化)
decrease by 減少了(多少)
a decrease in 在⋯方面的減少
The number of students has decreased this year.
(今年學生人數減少了。)
There was a sharp decrease in sales last month.
(上個月銷售量大幅下滑。)

deed(n.)行為、事蹟、契據
(無詞性變化)
good deed 善行
do a good deed 做好事
Helping the old man was a good deed.
(幫助那位老先生是一件善行。)
Actions speak louder than words, so judge people by their deeds.
(行動勝於言語，所以要從行為來評斷一個人。)

deepen(v.)加深、使變深
deep(adj.)深的
depth(n.)深度
deepen understanding 加深理解
deepen a friendship 加深友誼
Traveling abroad deepened my understanding of other cultures.
(出國旅行加深了我對其他文化的理解。)
Their friendship deepened over the years.
(他們的友誼隨著歲月加深。)

definition(n.)定義、清晰度
define(v.)下定義
definite(adj.)明確的
by definition 按照定義、本質上
high definition 高畫質
Look up the definition of this word in the dictionary.
(在字典裡查這個字的定義。)
This TV shows pictures in high definition.
(這台電視能顯示高畫質影像。)

democracy(n.)民主、民主政治
democratic(adj.)民主的
democrat(n.)民主主義者
freedom and democracy 自由與民主
fight for democracy 爭取民主
Taiwan is a young democracy in Asia.
(臺灣是亞洲一個年輕的民主國家。)
People in a democracy can vote for their leaders.
(在民主國家，人民可以投票選出領導人。)

democratic(adj.)民主的
democracy(n.)民主
democrat(n.)民主主義者
democratic country 民主國家
democratic process 民主程序
Everyone has the right to vote in a democratic country.
(在民主國家每個人都有投票權。)
The class made the decision in a democratic way.
(全班用民主的方式做出決定。)

deposit(n./v.)存款、訂金、押金、存放
(無詞性變化)
make a deposit 存款
pay a deposit 付訂金
I need to deposit some money in the bank.
(我需要去銀行存一些錢。)
We paid a deposit to rent the apartment.
(我們付了押金租下這間公寓。)

designer(n.)設計師
design(n./v.)設計
fashion designer 服裝設計師
graphic designer 平面設計師
She wants to become a fashion designer.
(她想成為服裝設計師。)
The designer created a new logo for the company.
(設計師為公司設計了新的標誌。)

desirable(adj.)令人嚮往的、值得擁有的
desire(n./v.)慾望、渴望
highly desirable 非常令人嚮往的
desirable result 理想的結果
A house near the MRT station is very desirable.
(靠近捷運站的房子非常搶手。)
Good communication skills are desirable for this job.
(這份工作最好具備良好的溝通能力。)

desire(n./v.)慾望、渴望、想要
desirable(adj.)令人嚮往的
a strong desire 強烈的渴望
desire for 對⋯的渴望
He has a strong desire to travel around the world.
(他非常渴望環遊世界。)
Everyone desires happiness and peace.
(人人都渴望幸福與和平。)

dessert(n.)甜點
(無詞性變化)
for dessert 當甜點
dessert shop 甜點店
We had mango ice for dessert.
(我們吃芒果冰當甜點。)
Let's save some room for dessert.
(我們留點胃吃甜點吧。)

destroy(v.)破壞、毀滅
destruction(n.)破壞
destructive(adj.)破壞性的
completely destroy 徹底摧毀
destroy the environment 破壞環境
The typhoon destroyed many houses in the village.
(颱風摧毀了村裡許多房屋。)
Plastic waste is destroying our oceans.
(塑膠垃圾正在破壞我們的海洋。)

detect(v.)察覺、偵測
detective(n.)偵探
detection(n.)偵查、察覺
detect a problem 發現問題
smoke detector 煙霧偵測器
The machine can detect metal in your bag.
(這台機器可以偵測你包包裡的金屬。)
I detected a hint of anger in her voice.
(我察覺到她的聲音裡帶著一絲怒氣。)

determine(v.)決定、確定、查明
determination(n.)決心
determined(adj.)下定決心的
determine the cause 查明原因
be determined to 決心要⋯
Your attitude determines your success.
(你的態度決定你的成功。)
The police are trying to determine the cause of the fire.
(警方正試著查明火災的原因。)

devil(n.)魔鬼、惡魔
devilish(adj.)惡魔般的
speak of the devil 說曹操曹操就到
the devil is in the details 魔鬼藏在細節裡
Speak of the devil! Here comes Jason.
(說曹操曹操就到！傑森來了。)
The little boy is a real devil at home.
(那個小男孩在家裡真是個小惡魔。)

dim(adj./v.)昏暗的、模糊的、使變暗
dimly(adv.)昏暗地、模糊地
dim light 昏暗的光線
dim the lights 調暗燈光
Don't read in such dim light.
(不要在這麼昏暗的光線下看書。)
The theater dimmed the lights before the movie started.
(電影開始前戲院把燈光調暗。)

dime(n.)(美國、加拿大的)一角硬幣
(無詞性變化)
a dime a dozen 多得很、不值錢
not a dime 一毛錢也沒有
A dime is worth ten cents.
(一角硬幣價值十分錢。)
Cheap phone cases are a dime a dozen.
(便宜的手機殼到處都是。)

dine(v.)用餐、進餐
dinner(n.)晚餐
diner(n.)用餐者、小餐館
dine out 外出用餐
dine in 在家用餐、內用
We usually dine out on Friday nights.
(我們通常週五晚上外出用餐。)
Would you like to dine in or take out?
(您要內用還是外帶？)

dinosaur(n.)恐龍
(無詞性變化)
dinosaur fossil 恐龍化石
dinosaur museum 恐龍博物館
Dinosaurs lived millions of years ago.
(恐龍生活在數百萬年前。)
We saw a huge dinosaur fossil at the museum.
(我們在博物館看到一具巨大的恐龍化石。)

dip(v./n.)浸、沾、下降、短暫游泳
(無詞性變化)
dip into 浸入、沾
take a dip 泡一下水、游個泳
Dip the fries into the ketchup.
(把薯條沾番茄醬。)
Let's take a quick dip in the pool.
(我們去游泳池泡一下水吧。)

dirt(n.)灰塵、泥土、汙垢
dirty(adj.)髒的
dirt road 泥土路
covered in dirt 滿是泥土
His shoes were covered in dirt after the hike.
(健行後他的鞋子沾滿了泥土。)
We drove down a narrow dirt road.
(我們沿著一條窄窄的泥土路開車。)

discount(n./v.)折扣、打折
(無詞性變化)
student discount 學生折扣
at a discount 打折(出售)
Students can get a ten percent discount here.
(學生在這裡可以打九折。)
The store discounts winter clothes in March.
(這家店三月會把冬裝打折。)

dishonest(adj.)不誠實的
dishonesty(n.)不誠實
honest(adj.)誠實的
dishonest behavior 不誠實的行為
it is dishonest to 做⋯是不誠實的
It is dishonest to copy someone else's homework.
(抄別人的作業是不誠實的。)
He lost his job because he was dishonest.
(他因為不誠實而丟了工作。)

disk(n.)磁碟、圓盤
disc(n.)光碟、圓盤(同 disk)
hard disk 硬碟
compact disc 光碟(CD)
Save the file on the hard disk.
(把檔案存在硬碟裡。)
My dad still keeps his old music discs.
(我爸爸還留著他的舊音樂光碟。)

dislike(v./n.)不喜歡、厭惡
like(v.)喜歡
dislike + V-ing 不喜歡做⋯
likes and dislikes 好惡
I dislike waiting in long lines.
(我不喜歡排長長的隊。)
Everyone has different likes and dislikes.
(每個人都有不同的好惡。)

ditch(n./v.)水溝、溝渠、拋棄
(無詞性變化)
dig a ditch 挖溝
ditch class 翹課
The car slid off the road into a ditch.
(車子滑出路面掉進水溝裡。)
He ditched his old phone for a new one.
(他丟掉舊手機換了一支新的。)

dive(n./v.)跳水、潛水、俯衝
diver(n.)潛水員、跳水者
diving(n.)潛水、跳水
dive into 跳入、投入
scuba diving 水肺潛水
She dove into the pool without fear.
(她毫不害怕地跳進泳池。)
We went scuba diving in Kenting.
(我們去墾丁玩水肺潛水。)

dizzy(adj.)頭暈的、暈眩的
dizziness(n.)頭暈
feel dizzy 覺得頭暈
make someone dizzy 使某人頭暈
I felt dizzy after the roller coaster ride.
(坐完雲霄飛車後我覺得頭暈。)
Standing up too fast can make you dizzy.
(站起來太快可能會讓你頭暈。)

dock(n./v.)碼頭、船塢、(船)停靠
(無詞性變化)
at the dock 在碼頭
dock at 停靠在⋯
The ship docked at Keelung Harbor this morning.
(那艘船今天早上停靠在基隆港。)
Fishermen were selling fish at the dock.
(漁夫們在碼頭賣魚。)

dolphin(n.)海豚
(無詞性變化)
dolphin watching 賞海豚
a pod of dolphins 一群海豚
We went dolphin watching in Hualien.
(我們去花蓮賞海豚。)
Dolphins are known to be very smart.
(海豚以非常聰明著稱。)

donkey(n.)驢子
(無詞性變化)
ride a donkey 騎驢
donkey work 苦差事
The farmer used a donkey to carry the bags.
(農夫用驢子來搬運袋子。)
He is as stubborn as a donkey.
(他固執得像頭驢。)

dose(n./v.)(藥的)一劑、劑量、給⋯服藥
dosage(n.)劑量
a dose of medicine 一劑藥
daily dose 每日劑量
Take one dose of this medicine after each meal.
(每餐飯後服用一劑這種藥。)
A small dose of humor can make a class more fun.
(一點點幽默就能讓課堂更有趣。)

doubtful(adj.)懷疑的、不確定的
doubt(n./v.)懷疑
doubtfully(adv.)懷疑地
be doubtful about 對⋯存疑
it is doubtful whether ⋯ 是否⋯令人懷疑
It is doubtful whether he will come today.
(他今天會不會來還很難說。)
My parents were doubtful about my plan.
(我爸媽對我的計畫存疑。)

doughnut(n.)甜甜圈
donut(n.)甜甜圈(美式拼法)
chocolate doughnut 巧克力甜甜圈
a box of doughnuts 一盒甜甜圈
I had a doughnut and coffee for breakfast.
(我早餐吃了一個甜甜圈配咖啡。)
She bought a box of doughnuts for the class.
(她買了一盒甜甜圈給全班。)

downtown(adj./adv./n.)市中心(的)、在市中心
(無詞性變化)
go downtown 去市區
downtown area 市中心區
Let's go downtown and see a movie.
(我們去市區看電影吧。)
The new hotel is in the downtown area.
(那家新飯店在市中心區。)

drag(v./n.)拖、拉、拖累、無聊的事
(無詞性變化)
drag on 拖延、拖拖拉拉
drag and drop 拖放(電腦操作)
He dragged the heavy box across the floor.
(他把重箱子拖過地板。)
The meeting dragged on for three hours.
(會議拖了三個小時。)

dragonfly(n.)蜻蜓
(無詞性變化)
red dragonfly 紅蜻蜓
catch a dragonfly 抓蜻蜓
A dragonfly landed on the tip of the grass.
(一隻蜻蜓停在草尖上。)
When I was little, I liked to catch dragonflies by the pond.
(我小時候喜歡在池塘邊抓蜻蜓。)

drain(v./n.)排水、耗盡、排水管
drainage(n.)排水系統
drain away 逐漸流失
brain drain 人才外流
Drain the water from the noodles before adding the sauce.
(加醬料前先把麵的水瀝乾。)
The long exam drained all my energy.
(那場漫長的考試耗盡了我所有精力。)

dramatic(adj.)戲劇性的、劇烈的、引人注目的
drama(n.)戲劇
dramatically(adv.)戲劇性地、大幅地
dramatic change 劇烈的變化
dramatic increase 大幅增加
There has been a dramatic change in the weather.
(天氣出現了劇烈的變化。)
Don't be so dramatic. It's just a small cut.
(別那麼誇張，只是個小傷口而已。)

drip(n./v.)滴、滴下、水滴聲
(無詞性變化)
drip coffee 滴濾咖啡
the drip of water 滴水聲
Water is dripping from the ceiling.
(水正從天花板滴下來。)
I couldn't sleep because of the drip of the faucet.
(水龍頭的滴水聲讓我睡不著。)

drown(v.)淹死、溺水、淹沒
drowning(n.)溺水
drown in 淹沒在⋯之中
drown out 蓋過(聲音)
Never swim alone, or you might drown.
(絕對不要獨自游泳，否則可能會溺水。)
The loud music drowned out our voices.
(大聲的音樂蓋過了我們的聲音。)

drugstore(n.)藥房、藥妝店
(無詞性變化)
go to the drugstore 去藥局
drugstore chain 連鎖藥妝店
I bought some cold medicine at the drugstore.
(我在藥局買了一些感冒藥。)
The drugstore on the corner is open until midnight.
(轉角那家藥妝店營業到半夜。)

drunk(adj./n.)喝醉的、醉漢
drunken(adj.)酒醉的
drink(v.)喝
get drunk 喝醉
drunk driving 酒駕
Drunk driving is very dangerous.
(酒駕非常危險。)
He got drunk at the party and fell asleep.
(他在派對上喝醉後睡著了。)

dumb(adj.)笨的、啞的、說不出話的
(無詞性變化)
a dumb question 蠢問題
play dumb 裝傻
There is no such thing as a dumb question.
(沒有所謂的蠢問題。)
Don't play dumb. I know you broke the vase.
(別裝傻，我知道是你打破了花瓶。)

dump(v./n.)傾倒、拋棄、垃圾場
(無詞性變化)
dump garbage 傾倒垃圾
garbage dump 垃圾場
It is illegal to dump garbage in the river.
(把垃圾倒進河裡是違法的。)
She dumped her boyfriend last week.
(她上星期甩了男朋友。)

dumpling(n.)餃子、湯圓、麵糰子
(無詞性變化)
steamed dumplings 蒸餃
soup dumplings 小籠包
We make dumplings together every Chinese New Year.
(我們每年過年都會一起包餃子。)
This restaurant is famous for its soup dumplings.
(這家餐廳以小籠包聞名。)

dust(n./v.)灰塵、撢去灰塵
dusty(adj.)滿是灰塵的
covered with dust 布滿灰塵
dust off 撢去灰塵、重新拿出來用
The old books on the shelf were covered with dust.
(架上的舊書布滿了灰塵。)
Please dust the furniture before the guests arrive.
(客人到之前請把家具的灰塵撢一撢。)

eager(adj.)渴望的、熱切的
eagerly(adv.)熱切地
eagerness(n.)渴望
be eager to 渴望去⋯
be eager for 渴望得到⋯
The students are eager to start the summer vacation.
(學生們渴望暑假趕快開始。)
She is eager for her parents' approval.
(她渴望得到父母的認可。)

echo(n./v.)回聲、回音、發出回聲、附和
(無詞性變化)
hear an echo 聽到回音
echo someone's words 附和某人的話
We heard the echo of our voices in the cave.
(我們在山洞裡聽到自己聲音的回音。)
Many students echoed his opinion.
(許多學生附和他的意見。)

edit(v.)編輯、校訂、剪輯
editor(n.)編輯
edition(n.)版本
edit a video 剪輯影片
edit an article 編輯文章
I spent the whole night editing my video.
(我花了一整晚剪輯我的影片。)
Please edit your essay before you hand it in.
(交作文之前請先修改一下。)

editor(n.)編輯、主編
edit(v.)編輯
editorial(n./adj.)社論、編輯的
chief editor 總編輯
magazine editor 雜誌編輯
She works as an editor for a fashion magazine.
(她在一家時尚雜誌擔任編輯。)
The editor asked me to make the story shorter.
